request_fields.message: Trainee text from the chat UI. Required.
request_fields.conversation_mode: stateless: one user turn, no stored history. threaded: server keeps messages keyed by session_id.
request_fields.reply_shape: chat_text: populate say. npc_actions: populate actions as ActionResponse. Both may be present.
request_fields.session_id: Required when conversation_mode is threaded. Unity generates one GUID per Play session.
request_fields.world: Structured snapshot from ContextLibrary (spots and NPC pose), not prompt text.

response_fields.say: Text for the chat UI. Used for chat_text; optional extra for npc_actions.
response_fields.actions: Array of { name, parameters[] } matching Unity ActionResponse. Used for npc_actions.
response_fields.session_id: Echo of the session used for this turn.

request.message: Move towards the farthest spot to you and tell me 3 funny jokes

actions.name: talk
parameters: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything. I told my doctor I broke my arm in two places. He told me to stop going there. Parallel lines have so much in common. It's a shame they'll never meet.
